## About
Wong's Performance Engineering is Portland and Vancouver's only GM-dedicated, high-performance tuning center. The work centers on engine control systems: finding the fault, fixing it and getting the car to run right.
Behind the shop is an electrical engineer. Our equipment is the same as what dealerships use. What we add is what dealers can't: passion, experience and personal attention.
We're rated 4.8 from 78 Google reviews. One reviewer put it simply: he knows those engines forwards and backwards.

## Services
- Dyno tune: A quality dyno tune for modified engines, done without rushing.
- Engine control system repair: We diagnose, repair and tune engine control systems, including the complex ones.
- ECM/PCM VATS bypass: VATS bypass for passlock issues. One customer had it done on a Chevy Suburban.
